Hi Sam —

Thanks for sending the questionnaire. Quick answers to the technical items you called out: 

- Cloud providers (production): primary compute and storage for hosted/managed customers runs on AWS (us-east-1 default). We also use GCP for select regional deployments and Azure for isolated partner environments; those are listed in the attached CSV with roles.
- Multi-region replication: for standard hosted customers we do not replicate customer content across regions by default. Replication is opt-in for DR/geo requirements and would be documented in the deployment config.
- Encryption & KMS: data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). We support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS / Google Cloud KMS) for encryption-at-rest and for specific artifacts (e.g., embedding stores) upon request.
- Retention: default retention for logs/conversation artifacts is 90 days for active debugging logs and 365 days for model telemetry/metrics; embeddings retention varies by customer configuration — we can support shorter or customer-defined retention via the Console + API.
- Third-party tools: we use Datadog for observability (ingested telemetry is metadata-only by default), Sentry for error reporting (scrubbed stack traces; customer payloads are not forwarded to Sentry), and a hosted analytics provider for aggregated usage metrics. Plaintext customer content is not shared with third-party analytics vendors.

I'll take the ACME spreadsheet and start filling the technical tabs. If you want, we can schedule a 30-min technical sync tomorrow or Wednesday to go through any high-risk items.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.inference
